explication: Convex is a reactive database platform for web applications: clients invoke server functions and subscribe to live query results, while the backend executes functions against consistent database state. The repository also includes file storage, snapshot import/export, search and vector indexing, and external data connectors. The map follows the client-to-function-to-database product shape and retains these documented capability branches. Several backend entry-point relationships are architectural rather than visible in the sampled excerpts, so those links are marked unverified.
